//: The hook matrix [S45, AR36]. Every theme answers every hook: with a selector scoped to that theme (a rule containing [data-theme='<name>'] in the named stylesheet), or with the word quiet and a reason. The default row is the shared base answer; a theme row overrides one hook at a time. gates/check-hooks.mjs refuses a theme that leaves a hook unanswered, a non-quiet answer whose selector is not scoped to the theme, and a quiet answer without a reason.

hooks.surface: data-kp-surface: hero or app — which ground a section stands on [TH116]
hooks.emphasis: <mark> — an emphasis the theme may reveal [TH120]
hooks.reveal: data-kp-reveal: headline, emphasis or rule — something that arrives [TH119, TH122]
hooks.accent: the heading accent: h1 and h2 inside a surface [TH122]

surface.quiet: one ground; both surfaces read the theme's own tokens (AR38 gives every theme the hero sources, C1)

reveal.quiet: no reveal; the element stands in its rest state

divider.quiet: no divider; a plain section boundary

accent.quiet: no accent beyond the heading's own type
